lines.en: What would you like to say?
: {i}Give me a few minutes and I'll join you.{/i}
: {i}I'm being serious. I'll just get Makoto to watch the class.{/i}
lines.zh: : {i}我是认真的。我让 Makoto 代管一下班。{/i}

lines.en: : {i}It's a little risky doing it during[school] hours :P{/i}
lines.zh: : {i}在[school]上课时间干这个有点冒险 :P{/i}
: {i}骗子。我们在体育课上就干过。{/i}

lines.en: : {i}Hahaha yes but I was reaaaaaaaally horny that day.{/i}
lines.zh: : {i}哈哈对，可我那天真的、真的好想要。{/i}

lines.en: : {i}Horny enough to get me to strip in the bathroom.{/i}
lines.zh: : {i}想要到能让我在洗手间里把衣服脱了。{/i}

lines.en: : {i}Once[school] is over, you can do me as much as you want!{/i}
: {i}How will we raise our child on no salary?{/i}
lines.zh: : {i}我们没薪水要怎么养孩子啊？{/i}

lines.en: : {i}You figure it out. You're the rich one.{/i}
lines.zh: : {i}你自己想办法。有钱的那个是你。{/i}

lines.en: : {i}Okay, come do me. Just be quick ;P{/i}
: {i}Cool picture, but you're missing a very important lesson right now.{/i}
lines.zh: : {i}照片不错，不过你现在正缺一堂很重要的课。{/i}

lines.en: : {i}Do you always teach when I leave the classroom?{/i}
lines.zh: : {i}我离开教室的时候你总是在讲课吗？{/i}

lines.en: : {i}Yes. And, at this rate, you're going to be held back.{/i}
lines.zh: : {i}是。而且照这个进度，你要被留级了。{/i}

lines.en: : {i}What if I let you cum on face?{/i}
lines.zh: : {i}那如果我让你射在我脸上呢？{/i}

lines.en: : {i}These text messages will be used as proof of harassment.{/i}
lines.zh: : {i}这些短信会被当作骚扰的证据。{/i}

lines.en: : {i}Is this because I kept my underwear on?{/i}
: {i}Well I was GOING to send you another one without them but not anymore.{/i}
lines.zh: : {i}我本来还打算再发一张不穿的给你，现在不发了。{/i}

lines.en: : {i}Just kidding please don't leave me I love you so much.{/i}
lines.zh: : {i}开玩笑的，请别离开我，我好爱你。{/i}

lines.en: : {i}Come back to class looking like that and I'll let you do whatever you want for the rest of the day.{/i}
lines.zh: : {i}就这个样子回教室来，今天剩下的时间你想干什么都行。{/i}

lines.en: : {i}But you already let me do whatever I want because we're in looooooove.{/i}
lines.zh: : {i}可你本来就让我干什么都行啊，因为我们在——恋爱。{/i}

lines.en: : {i}True. But I want to see how everyone else would react.{/i}
lines.zh: : {i}没错。但我想看看别人会有什么反应。{/i}

lines.en: : {i}Stop writing love with that many o's.{/i}
lines.zh: : {i}别把 love 写那么多 o。{/i}

lines.en: : {i}I can't. My o key is stuck.{/i}
lines.zh: : {i}不行。我的 o 键卡住了。{/i}

lines.en: : {i}Your phone is touch screen and you typed it just fine there.{/i}
lines.zh: : {i}你手机是触屏，刚才那儿不是打得好好的。{/i}
